pcs.pc_description: prepare the preventive maintenance schedule and checklists as per operation and maintenance manual
communicate maintenance plan to all the stakeholders like site supervisor/ project manager/ maintenance manager/ labor in-charge/ material manager/ contract labor etc as per organizational protocol
arrange for procurement of machine / equipment parts whenever necessary as per organization protocol
make the availability of spares and consumables for repair work or raise indent for the same much before the preventive maintenance schedule
plan and schedule availability of mechanics, technicians, labor in adequate numbers to carry out preventive maintenance
arrange for inspection and validation, if all the tools used to monitor the functioning of the equipment are calibrated and certified by competent authority
planning and operationalization of the field workshop/ service, as required
supervise equipment commissioning/ installation process
comply with all organizational guidelines, SHE policy and quality standards during equipment maintenance
supervise the enforcement of all HSE related guidelines in equipment maintenance
carry out periodic walk-through to ensure that the service/ field workshop area is clean and free from hazards as per the safety, health and environmental policy/ guidelines
supervise the storage, handling and disposal of waste based on environmental guidelines at the work place

share equipment wise checklists and work schedule with the mechanics to ensure correct type of service (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, half yearly and yearly)/ maintenance activities are completed
assist the manager in monitoring maintenance operations with regards to timelines and budgets
ensure that third party equipment installed at the work place; preventive maintenance as per agreed schedule/ annual maintenance contract with the vendor
help and guide the mechanics while they are carrying out the repairs, as required
check the workmanship of mechanics/ technicians and other personnel
ensure the faulty components are replaced / repaired on the site or sent to vendor for repair through material department
assist the workshop / P&M manager in ensuring the quality of workmanship of third party vendors
check if the preventive maintenance work is complete as per the checklists provided to all the mechanics
get a sign-off from the end user of the equipment like site engineer and / or project head as per organizational protocol
document the details of the vendors in log- books / organizational reports/ MIS/ vendors worksheets etc. as per organizational protocol

complete documentation applicable to the role like reports, preventive maintenance log- books, spare parts usage log-books, sign-off reports, management information reports and other reports as per the quality & reporting standards applicable to the organization
keep all the records in a way and at a place where it is easily accessible to the relevant personnel

pcs.pc_description: formulate in consultation with the P&M/ Workshop Maintenance Manager the system of maintenance cycle for Plant & machinery (P&M)
divide the manpower of mechanics and other support personnel into teams and make them responsible for planned and unplanned work, based on the frequency and severity of breakdowns
plan for natural and manmade contingencies

create a predictive tests and analysis such as pressure , temperature, wear & tear checks, oil leakage test, hydraulic systems check, engine stress and gas exhaust system tests, wire life assessments etc. in consultation and advice of manager

provide data to manager about key performance parameters (like mean time between break -downs, cost of maintenance, power consumption, water consumption, oil and gas consumption, manpower utilization etc) as per cma procedures
design a system by which the supervisor is informed about the break-down as soon as it occurs
identify the problem quickly by performing diagnostic breakdown analysis, study the equipment manuals
cordon off the area, switch off power source, move personnel to safe area, in-case of an emergency
deploy mechanics to address the break down, as per organization protocols
take immediate action so that the break down is rectified
run the equipment after the repair to ensure its working appropriately and safely
note down all the critical parameters of performance of the equipment post repair
take sign off from production/ operation/ project manager under whose jurisdiction the equipment is working
give information and data to manager so as to make changes, if any, in the preventive maintenance schedule
ensure all the relevant stakeholders are informed about the rectification
ensure entries are made in log-books, ERP and other organization specified reports

pcs.pc_description: comply with all latest/current workshop safety, personal health, security and environmental related regulations and guidelines
inspect the work area and ensure it is safe from hazards, clean and with adequate lighting and ventilation as applicable, to enable repairs to be carried out efficiently
use appropriate personal protective clothing and equipment for various tasks and work conditions as per regulations
lift or haul as necessary, various tools and equipment safely from stowage area to repair bay as per the laid down procedures
carry out all repairs and maintenance tasks safely and correctly as per the manufacturers workshop procedures and guidelines
store the tools and equipment, post usage, at the designated places and ensure they are not left behind in the repair bay
keep the work area free from clutter and spillage on a regular basis to maintain basic hygiene and cleanliness at all times
handle the storage and disposal of waste including hazardous materials as per the safety, health and environmental regulations
operate various types and grades of fire extinguishers, as per the laid down procedures
support in administering basic first aid at the spot and report to supervisor, as required, in case of an accident needing evacuation
respond promptly and appropriately to any accident / incident or emergency, within the limits of ones roles and responsibilities
report and record, as applicable, details related to operations, incidents or accidents, in a factually correct manner
